threshold_correction.scope: The construction upper bound alone gives sufficiency. Conditional on inherited MM5/R011 bounds, A_N^5/N -> 0 is also necessary for vanishing worst-source actual-terminal expected TV on the complete arbitrary-initial homogeneous second-order source class, using inf_Q sup_(theta,mu) with one Q throughout the source supremum. It is not a pointwise fixed-source, every-subclass, or internal-network-resource optimality result. The displayed fixed-risk necessary constant is restricted to 0 < r < 2^-16.
threshold_correction.chronology: These are existing separate published clarifications of the same overbroad threshold wording. They were not newly authored as a response to SGA001; no such causal chronology is asserted. The correction reviewer explicitly corrects that reviewer's earlier synthesis review; no identity claim tying that reviewer to SGA001 is made.
